messages:
ae_maya: Heads-up: Covalent (Liz) on POC. They're seeing inconsistent first-token times: 600ms-1.2s for short completions (~10-30 tokens). Cold-starts still after 15min of low steady traffic. Also hit 429s during a load test at ~9rps. Can we triage?
se_derek: Share a trace id and the deployment name + model. Is this Hosted or Dedicated?
ae_maya: trace_id=20260322T09:12Z/t-cc34; model=open-redwood/gptj-6b-quant; deployment=dedicated-covalent-eu.
eng_sre_anya: pulling logs for t-cc34. I see nodes reporting 'cold_shard_spinup' around request time and repeated kvcache_ttl_expired warnings. Also batching shows batch_size=1 but batch_wait=80ms which is odd — looks like the auto-batcher isn't seeing coalesced work so it's waiting full window. Log snippet: 
```
WARN cache: kvcache_ttl_expired key=ctx:covalent:user:xyz ttl=0
INFO shard: cold_shard_spinup id=shard-17 start_ms=87
INFO batching: queued=1 window_ms=80 reason=idle
DEBUG runtime: kv_prefetch_enqueue miss=true
```
eng_runtime_sam: Two hypotheses: (A) KV keys are too short-lived so every request misses the warm cache, causing runtime to fall back to cold init paths; (B) The route's batching policy is set to prioritize throughput, so short requests wait for batch_window to fill.
se_derek: Quick remediation options: 1) temporarily increase kv_ttl for Covalent keys to 5m (reduces cold path), 2) set route.purpose="interactive" to lower batch_window_ms to 8ms and max_batch=4, 3) enable soft-prefetch of the most common prefixes.
eng_sre_anya: I can patch kv_ttl via internal-admin: 
```bash
redwoodctl kv update --deployment dedicated-covalent-eu --key-prefix ctx:covalent --ttl 300
```
eng_sre_anya: Patch applied (op id kvp-221). Also toggled route purpose -> interactive (op id route-904).
deploy-bot: updated deployment dedicated-covalent-eu: route.profile=interactive, batch_window_ms=8, max_batch_size=4 (change id c-7721)
eng_runtime_sam: I also deployed a small prefetch job that writes the top 20 prefixes into the kvcache for the next 30 minutes (job pf-cc20).
customer_liz: Ran a quick replay against the POC endpoint after changes. Median TTFT improved to ~180ms, p95 ~320ms. Saw one 429 when ramping from 0->10rps during the replay.
se_derek: The single 429 likely hit per-shard in-flight limit while shards were spinning up. We can add a short ramp policy on the ingress (allow bursts but throttle sustained) or temporarily increase per-shard concurrency. Thoughts @ae_maya?
ae_maya: Customer demo in 90m. We should allow a temporary concurrency bump to avoid demo blips.
eng_sre_anya: I raised per-shard concurrency from 10->18 for dedicated-covalent-eu for 2 hours (change id thr-880). Also added a short-lived alert: alert if cold_shard_spinup_count > 3 in 5m.
sec_rohan: Covalent asked about key management and audit retention. I'll send the KMS integration summary and retention policy excerpt. @ae_maya please share their legal contact.
finance_mina: Pricing note for AE: For a 6 GPU dedicated POC, baseline reserved guidance is ~$28k/month. If they want burst protection during launch we can propose a short-term uplift (monthly add-on) or a usage buffer billed weekly. I'll draft quick numbers.
customer_liz: After the kv_ttl + interactive route change we no longer see the long tail on short prompts. Big improvement for the demo flow. Thanks team!
se_derek: Keeping monitoring on for the next 3 hours. If cold_shard_spinup alerts persist we'll schedule a sidecar warmup that pins a warm replica. Post-demo retro to document the recommended kvcache TTLs and route policy for Covalent.
ae_maya: I'll follow up with the customer and send the security docs + pricing. Closing this thread after the demo. Thanks all :rocket:
